title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Time-Limited Writing – Position and Full Argumentation
prompt: Some people believe that the best way to reduce traffic congestion in large cities is to make public transport free for everyone, while others think that investing in better cycling infrastructure is more effective. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为限时写作练习，主题是“立场与充分论证”。请在40分钟内完成一篇至少250词的议论文。注意：所有场景和数据均为模拟，并非官方雅思试卷。写作时请：1) 明确讨论双方观点；2) 给出你自己的立场；3) 用充分论证支持你的观点，避免只罗列观点。
